coverage_sections.topic: Starting probability system, events, invariant sets, ergodicity
Function algebras, integration as a state, automorphisms, Koopman action
Irrational orbit quotient, crossed product, regular representation, center, trace and freeness
Derivations, smooth torus, flow, leaves and transverse return map
State-preserving noncommutative systems and beginning of the unitary-group matrix example
Three-point probability, coordinate algebra, three-cycle, transposition, identity and general n-cycle
Standard Gaussian, orthogonal linear maps, radial invariant, CDF coordinates, arbitrary measurable maps, conjugacy, invertibility and doubling
Embeddings, Archimedean algebra, trace pairing, lattice quotient, codifferent, Fourier characters, single and joint translation criteria, Gaussian integers
Group action axioms, unitarity, reduced representation, fixed functions, mean and pointwise averages
Spectral resolution, correlation coefficients, eigenfunctions, weak and strong mixing, discrete spectrum and Halmos–von Neumann
Finite, toral, cat-map and Gaussian examples
Continuous time, Stone generator, Hamiltonian transport, Howe–Moore, spectral gaps, property T
Visible beginning of multiple recurrence and arithmetic progressions
